snippet.title: The Dropouts - Official Release Window Trailer | Dames 4 Games Halloween Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Watch the Release Window Trailer for The Dropouts, a third-person stylized psychological horror game developed by Naraven Games. Players will assume the role of a transfer student named Lou where perculiar things begin to partake in Noirmont High in 2004 Switzerland. Make key decisions in The Dropouts, launching in 2026 for Nintendo Switch and PC (Steam).
